messages:
jess: Need a short-lived deploy token to push v3.2.1-rc7 in the 14:00 change window. My MFA device is at the vendor for RMA, can't do normal deploy. Can someone from deployer rota approve? @deploy-bot kick off the approval flow please.

deploy-bot: Request logged: delegate token request for jess -> target: v3.2.1-rc7, expires: 1h. Required approvers: 2 from group 'deployer'. Approvers can reply with 'approve' or use /approve-deploy <thread>. Audit tags must include: release, reason.

raj: I can approve but want confirmation we pin runtime to 1.4.2 and quant-profile=q8_0. We had a perf regression earlier.

oncall-tim: I'm oncall until 15:00, can approve. Note: policy requires at least one SRE + one deploy lead. I can be the SRE approver.

sec-sarah: Sec OK with temporary delegation as long as token TTL <= 1h and audit tags set. Leave 'reason=prod-critical-tweak' and add 'rotation_ticket=SEC-912'. Also run smoke+canary and snapshot k8s manifests. :white_check_mark: 

morgan: Fallback plan: rollback target pinned to v3.2.0@sha256:abcd1234 if canary fails. Please tag rollback runbook in thread.

sam: Release notes updated -> https://docs.internal/releases/3.2.1-rc7.md. Contains change to embedding path; test vector included.

raj: approve (raj) :thumbsup: 

oncall-tim: approve (oncall-tim) :white_check_mark: 

deploy-bot: Approval count: 2/2. Generating token... token id dtk_9bXf82 (redacted). Expires at 2025-11-05T15:30:00Z. Audit tags applied: [release=3.2.1-rc7, reason=prod-critical-tweak, rotation_ticket=SEC-912]

jess: Got token, starting canary now. Will post smoke logs here. Canary targets: traffic 1%, 15m.

jess: [logs]
```
2025-11-05T15:05:12Z canary start: success
2025-11-05T15:10:03Z smoke: embedding endpoint OK (latency p95 120ms)
```

morgan: Canary looks clean. Proceed to ramp to 20% then 100% over 30m. If any error rate >1% roll back immediately.

jess: Ramping. tagging rollout=v3.2.1-rc7-canary

deploy-bot: Noted rollout tag. If rollback command received '/rollback v3.2.0' will trigger automated rollback and incident stub.

jess: All good at 100% after 35m. Closing delegate token session. Thanks everyone. :tada:
